parts.text: Can you tell me about product P001? I want to know what it does and how much it costs.

CloudSync Pro (P001) is an enterprise cloud storage and file synchronization solution priced at $29/user/month. It offers real-time sync, 256-bit AES encryption, up to 10TB storage, team collaboration, and 90-day version history. It supports Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.
I'm getting error E001 on CloudSync Pro. My files stopped syncing. What should I do?

Error E001 is a known issue where CloudSync Pro sync stalls after a sleep/wake cycle. The workaround is to quit and relaunch the CloudSync Pro desktop client from the system tray or menu bar. A permanent fix is expected in v4.2.1.
I think DataVault Backup corrupted my files during the last backup job and now I can't restore them. This is a production database and we need it urgently!

I understand this is urgent — potential data loss on a production database is critical. I'm escalating this immediately to our specialist team with critical priority. You'll receive a response within 1 hour.
Can you help me write a Python script to scrape a website?

I'm sorry, that falls outside what I can help with as a product support agent. I'm here to assist with CloudSync Pro, DataVault Backup, and SecureConnect VPN. Is there anything related to those products I can help you with?
This is ridiculous! My VPN keeps dropping every time I switch to a different WiFi network. I have a critical meeting in 30 minutes and I can't work like this!

I'm really sorry you're dealing with this right before an important meeting — that's incredibly stressful. The VPN drop on network switch is a known issue (E003). You can fix it immediately by enabling Auto-Reconnect: go to Settings → Connection → Enable Auto-Reconnect. Updating to v3.1.0 also permanently resolves this. I hope this gets you back online in time for your meeting.
What can you tell me about product P999?

I wasn't able to find a product with the ID P999. Our available products are P001 (CloudSync Pro), P002 (DataVault Backup), and P003 (SecureConnect VPN). Could you double-check the product ID, or let me know which product you're interested in?
